purpose: Verify standard success path for CL: Apply -> Substitute Accepts -> Unit Head Approves -> Sanctioned
preconditions: Employee with CL balance, eligible substitute, assigned Unit Head
action_or_input: Apply for CL, substitute accepts, Unit Head sanctions
expected_result: Final status is SANCTIONED, balance debited

purpose: Verify substitute decline path: Apply -> Substitute Declines -> Applicant Renominates -> New Substitute Accepts -> Approved
action_or_input: Substitute declines, applicant renominates substitute 2, substitute 2 accepts, Unit Head approves
expected_result: Final status is SANCTIONED after successful renomination and approval

purpose: Verify rejection path at Unit Head: Apply -> Substitute Accepts -> Unit Head Rejects
action_or_input: Unit Head issues rejection decision with remarks
expected_result: Status is REJECTED, reserved balance is unlocked

purpose: Verify higher sanction flow: Apply EL -> Substitute Accepts -> Unit Head Recommends -> Admin Verifies -> Higher Authority Sanctions
preconditions: Employee applying for EL requiring higher sanction
action_or_input: Follow full higher sanction chain to approval
expected_result: Status transitions to SANCTIONED after Director/Dean approval

purpose: Verify higher authority rejection: Unit Head Recommends -> Higher Authority Rejects
Verify applicant withdrawal path while request is in PENDING_SUBSTITUTE or PENDING_APPROVAL
expected_result: Status transitions immediately to WITHDRAWN and workflow terminates

purpose: Verify Director self-sanction flow: Director Applies -> Auto/Self-Sanctioned without routing to subordinate
Verify cancellation workflow: Approved Leave -> Applicant Requests Cancellation -> Authority Approves -> Cancelled
action_or_input: Applicant submits cancellation, sanctioning authority approves cancellation
expected_result: Status transitions to CANCELLED and leave balance restored

purpose: Verify cancellation rejection: Authority rejects cancellation request
expected_result: Original leave remains SANCTIONED and leave days remain debited

purpose: Verify extension workflow: Ongoing Leave -> Applicant Submits Extension -> Unit Head Recommends -> Authority Sanctions
action_or_input: Submit extension with new end date, obtain recommendation and sanction
expected_result: Extension approved, leave end date updated, additional days debited
Extension status REJECTED; original leave end date remains unchanged

purpose: Verify standard duty resumption flow: Return from Leave -> Submit Resumption -> Unit Head Approves -> Closed
action_or_input: Submit resumption on scheduled return date, Unit Head approves
expected_result: Resumption status APPROVED, leave record closed

purpose: Verify early resumption flow: Return Early -> Submit Early Resumption -> Unit Head Approves -> Balance Credited
preconditions: Sanctioned leave ongoing; employee reports early
action_or_input: Submit early resumption with actual reporting date, Unit Head approves
expected_result: Leave period truncated to actual return date, unused balance credited back

purpose: Verify late resumption flow: Return Late -> Submit Late Resumption -> Flagged for Regularization
preconditions: Employee returns after sanctioned end date
expected_result: Resumption recorded with late status flag requiring administrative regularization

purpose: Verify offline sanction recording workflow by Admin/Establishment
action_or_input: Submit offline sanction record with paper order details and past dates
expected_result: Offline record stored, status is SANCTIONED, balance updated, audit log created
All employee CL balances lapsed to 0; faculty VL converted to EL at 2:1 up to 300 cap

purpose: Verify SLA scheduled workflow: Scan Pending Tasks -> Dispatch Reminder -> Dispatch Escalation upon further delay
preconditions: Pending task exceeds reminder threshold and subsequently escalation threshold
expected_result: Generates SLA reminder and escalation notifications according to configured hours
